When I was younger I had only heard the hits of The Human League but I hadn't heard this until I got some more of their albums, in between that I had heard a song I liked by Richard X called Finest Dreams which when I eventually got my hands on Dare I then learnt samples the music from The Things That Dreams Are Made Of.

Interestingly there's an album compiled by Richard X "The Golden Hour of the Future" which features songs from the original line-up of The Human League and the previous band The Future. It has much more of an industrial sound rather than pop which they're know for today, 4JG is a cool track inspired by the futuristic writings of J G Ballard.
Thanks for this, I hadn't heard of Richard X before. I'll have to set aside time to check more of him out.

It would be a bit tricky to get all his work in one place as currently he only has one album (Richard X Presents His X-Factor Vol. 1), he's mostly a remixer and producer.
